left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Participants must have histologically  [OR] or cytologically confirmed invasive  [OR] or in-situ carcinoma  [AND] of the breast and will undergo unilateral breast cancer surgery
  -  Willingness to complete SEI-BCLE Questionnaire
  -  Age >18 years

-  Ability to understand  [AND] and the willingness to verbally consent to the trial
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  History of primary lymphedema

right.raw_text: -  Any patient with a current case of cellulitis

left.raw_text: -  Participants with known brain metastases should be excluded from this clinical trial because of their poor prognosis  [AND] and because they often develop progressive neurologic dysfunction that would confound the evaluation of neurologic  [OR] and other adverse events

-  Uncontrolled intercurrent illness including, but not limited to, ongoing  [OR] or active infection, symptomatic congestive heart failure, unstable angina pectoris, [OR]  cardiac arrhythmia, [OR]  or psychiatric illness/ [OR] social situations that would limit compliance with study requirements

right.raw_text: -  Participants unable to abduct  [OR] upper-extremity perpendicular to body or to stand comfortably without aid for several minutes, both of which are necessary to perform a LymphaTech Scan
